For U2, we will create a new REST controller that exposes an endpoint to invoke the existing RabbitBindingCleaner, adhering to existing REST API conventions.
For U3, we will profile the YARN deployer to identify bottlenecks and apply optimizations such as caching or parallel execution where feasible.

For U4, U5, and U7, we will update dependency versions in the build configuration (e.g., Maven/Gradle) and perform thorough testing to ensure backward compatibility, making minimal code adjustments if necessary.
For U6, we will extend the Kafka bus configuration to allow setting a partitioning key even when there is a single downstream module, by modifying the producer configuration logic.
For U8, we will add a documentation section that describes the limitations of HSQL DB when used with composed jobs, based on known issues and testing.
assumptions: All user stories are independent and can be implemented concurrently with minimal interdependencies.

Existing codebases for Mesos SPI, Rabbit binder, YARN deployer, and Kafka bus are well-structured and documented, making changes straightforward.
Upgrades (U4, U5, U7) do not introduce breaking changes that require significant refactoring; any needed changes are minor and localized.
Integration and regression testing across all changes can be performed in a single activity after individual implementations are complete.
Effort estimates include analysis, design, implementation, unit testing, integration testing, and documentation for each activity where applicable.
